```{r Read and Merge TimeSeries Expression Data}
library(data.table)

# Initialize list to store results
Species_TimeSeries_Expression <- list()

# Loop through each element in Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants
for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  element <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]]

  # Extract species info
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(substr(species_name, 1, 1), "_", substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name)))

  # Find all relevant files
  species_files <- list.files(
    path = R_Data,
    pattern = paste0("^", species_prefix, ".*TimeSeries_([0-9]+).*"),
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(species_files) == 0) next  # Skip if no matching files found

  # Read and process all files efficiently with data.table
  file_dt_list <- lapply(species_files, function(f) {
    tryCatch({
      dt <- fread(f, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
      # Clean up header
      setnames(dt, gsub("#", "", names(dt)))

      # Ensure we map the first two columns to gene_id and Expression_value
      if (ncol(dt) < 2) stop("file has fewer than 2 columns: ", f)
      setnames(dt, old = names(dt)[1:2], new = c("gene_id", "Expression_value"))

      # Coerce expression to numeric (safely)
      dt[, Expression_value := as.numeric(Expression_value)]

      # Compute log2(expression + 1)
      dt[, log2_Expression_Plus_One := log2(Expression_value + .5)]
      #dt[, log2_Expression_Plus_One := (Expression_value + 1)]

      # Extract timepoint number from filename
      tp <- sub(".*TimeSeries_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", basename(f))
      dt[, time_point := tp]

      # Keep only required columns
      #dt[, .(gene_id, time_point, log2_Expression_Plus_One)]
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Failed reading ", f, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
  })

  # Drop any NULL results from failed reads
  file_dt_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), file_dt_list)
  if (length(file_dt_list) == 0) next

  # Combine all timepoints into one long data.table
  combined_long <- rbindlist(file_dt_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

  # If there are duplicated (gene_id, time_point) pairs, aggregate (mean) them:
  # (change mean to sum/median/first if you prefer)
  if (any(duplicated(combined_long[, .(gene_id, time_point)]))) {
    combined_long <- combined_long[, .(log2_Expression_Plus_One = mean(log2_Expression_Plus_One, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                   by = .(gene_id, time_point)]
  }

  # Pivot wider — use time_point as the column variable and log2_Expression_Plus_One as the values
  merged_expression_wide <- dcast(
    combined_long,
    gene_id ~ time_point,
    value.var = "log2_Expression_Plus_One",
    fun.aggregate = mean,
    fill = NA
  )

  # Rename timepoint columns to include the prefix
  time_cols <- setdiff(names(merged_expression_wide), "gene_id")
  setnames(merged_expression_wide, old = time_cols, new = paste0("log2_Expression_Plus_One", time_cols))

  # Merge expression matrix into the Annotated VCF (ensure both are data.tables)
  element_dt <- as.data.table(element)
  element_expression <- merge(
    element_dt,
    merged_expression_wide,
    by.x = "GENE_ID",
    by.y = "gene_id",
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  # Save the updated element back into the list
  Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]] <- element_expression

  # Store the raw list of data.tables if you need them later
  Species_TimeSeries_Expression[[species_name]] <- file_dt_list
}
```

```{r Expression Versus Mutation Rate Associations}
# ============================================================
# 1 Mutation Rate vs Expression Associations (ALL + MUTATED ONLY)
# Keep the raw mutation column name as the storage key.
# Use a separate display label only for plotting/text.
# ============================================================

mutation_display_label <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(
    x,
    "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "All variants",
    "TtoA_or_AtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "T>A / A>T",
    "CtoT_or_GtoA_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "C>T / G>A",
    "TtoG_or_AtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "T>G / A>C",
    "CtoG_or_GtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "C>G / G>C",
    "CtoA_or_GtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "C>A / G>T",
    "TtoC_or_AtoG_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "T>C / A>G",
    "UniqueSynonymousVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "Synonymous",
    "UniqueIntronicVariantsPlusOnePerBP" = "Intronic",
    .default = x
  )
}

# Mutation columns to iterate over
mutation_cols <- c(
  "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "TtoA_or_AtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "CtoT_or_GtoA_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "TtoG_or_AtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "CtoG_or_GtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "CtoA_or_GtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "TtoC_or_AtoG_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "UniqueSynonymousVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "UniqueIntronicVariantsPlusOnePerBP"
)

# Initialise master lists ONCE
Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests <- list()
Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests  <- list()

Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly <- list()
Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests_MutatedOnly  <- list()

# ============================================================
# MAIN LOOP
# ============================================================
for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  df_full <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]]

  # Extract species
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(substr(species_name, 1, 1), "_", substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name)))

  # Expression columns
  expr_cols <- grep("^log2_Expression_Plus_One", colnames(df_full), value = TRUE)

  # Create species-level lists only if they do not already exist
  if (is.null(Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species_name]])) {
    Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species_name]] <- list()
    Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests[[species_name]]  <- list()

    Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly[[species_name]] <- list()
    Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests_MutatedOnly[[species_name]]  <- list()
  }

  # ============================================================
  # LOOP OVER MUTATION TYPES
  # ============================================================
  for (mutation_col in mutation_cols) {

    if (!(mutation_col %in% colnames(df_full))) next

    # raw key used for storage
    mutation_key <- mutation_col

    # human-readable label used only for plots/text
    mutation_label <- mutation_display_label(mutation_key)

    # Create nested lists only if they do not already exist
    if (is.null(Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species_name]][[mutation_key]])) {
      Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species_name]][[mutation_key]] <- list()
      Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests[[species_name]][[mutation_key]]  <- list()

      Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly[[species_name]][[mutation_key]] <- list()
      Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests_MutatedOnly[[species_name]][[mutation_key]]  <- list()
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 1) ALL GENES
    # ============================================================
    for (expr_col in expr_cols) {

      time_label <- sub("log2_Expression_Plus_One", "", expr_col)
      plot_tag   <- paste0(species_name, "_Time_", time_label, "_", mutation_key)

      spearman_test <- cor.test(df_full[[expr_col]], log1p(df_full[[mutation_col]]), method = "spearman")
      pearson_test  <- cor.test(df_full[[expr_col]], log1p(df_full[[mutation_col]]), method = "pearson")

      Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species_name]][[mutation_key]][[time_label]] <- spearman_test
      Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests[[species_name]][[mutation_key]][[time_label]]  <- pearson_test

      plotting_data <- df_full[!is.na(df_full[[expr_col]]), ]

      p1 <- ggplot(
        plotting_data,
        aes(x = .data[[expr_col]], y = log1p(.data[[mutation_col]]))
      ) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
        labs(
          title = paste(species_name, "\n", time_label, "min"),
          subtitle = paste0(
            mutation_label, " | ",
            "Spearman: p=", signif(spearman_test$p.value, 4),
            " (ρ=", signif(spearman_test$estimate, 3), "); ",
            "Pearson: p=", signif(pearson_test$p.value, 4),
            " (r=", signif(pearson_test$estimate, 3), ")"
          ),
          caption = "Linear regression overlay"
        )

      ggsave(
        p1,
        filename = paste0(
          R_Data, "Plots/6_Mutation_and_TimeSeries_Expression_Association_Plots/",
          species_prefix, "/",
          plot_tag, "_Linear_Association_Plot.png"
        ),
        width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300, create.dir = TRUE
      )
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 2) MUTATED ONLY
    # ============================================================
    df_mut <- df_full[df_full[["UniqueVariants"]] > 0, ]

    for (expr_col in expr_cols) {

      time_label <- sub("log2_Expression_Plus_One", "", expr_col)
      plot_tag   <- paste0(species_name, "_Time_", time_label, "_", mutation_key)

      spearman_test <- cor.test(df_mut[[expr_col]], log1p(df_mut[[mutation_col]]), method = "spearman")
      pearson_test  <- cor.test(df_mut[[expr_col]], log1p(df_mut[[mutation_col]]), method = "pearson")

      Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly[[species_name]][[mutation_key]][[time_label]] <- spearman_test
      Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests_MutatedOnly[[species_name]][[mutation_key]][[time_label]]  <- pearson_test

      plotting_data <- df_mut[!is.na(df_mut[[expr_col]]), ]

      p1 <- ggplot(
        plotting_data,
        aes(x = .data[[expr_col]], y = log1p(.data[[mutation_col]]))
      ) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
        labs(
          title = paste(species_name, "MutatedOnly", "\n", time_label, "min"),
          subtitle = paste0(
            mutation_label, " | ",
            "Spearman: p=", signif(spearman_test$p.value, 4),
            " (ρ=", signif(spearman_test$estimate, 3), "); ",
            "Pearson: p=", signif(pearson_test$p.value, 4),
            " (r=", signif(pearson_test$estimate, 3), ")"
          ),
          caption = "Linear regression overlay"
        )

      ggsave(
        p1,
        filename = paste0(
          R_Data, "Plots/6_Mutation_and_TimeSeries_Expression_Association_Plots/",
          species_prefix, "/",
          plot_tag, "_MutatedOnly_Linear_Association_Plot.png"
        ),
        width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300, create.dir = TRUE
      )
    }
  }
}
```

```{r TimeSeries Summary Plots}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ============================================================
# FLATTEN STRUCTURE (species → mutation → time)
# ============================================================
Spearman_summary <- lapply(names(Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests), function(species) {

  species_list <- Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species]]

  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(species_list), function(mutation_key) {

    mutation_list <- species_list[[mutation_key]]

    data.frame(
      species     = species,
      mutation    = mutation_key,
      timepoint   = as.numeric(names(mutation_list)),
      coefficient = sapply(mutation_list, function(x) unname(x$estimate)),
      p_value     = sapply(mutation_list, function(x) x$p.value),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

  }))

}) %>% bind_rows()

# ============================================================
# BASIC CLEAN + TRANSFORM
# ============================================================
Spearman_summary <- Spearman_summary %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = ifelse(p_value < 1e-300, 1e-300, p_value),
    neglog10p = -log10(p_value)
  )

Spearman_summary$species <- factor(
  Spearman_summary$species,
  levels = c("Dmelanogaster", "Celegans", "Ppacificus")
)

Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "All Variants"
Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "TtoA_or_AtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "T>A / A>T"
Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "CtoT_or_GtoA_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "C>T / G>A"
Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "TtoG_or_AtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "T>G / A>C"
Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "CtoG_or_GtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "C>G / G>C"
Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "CtoA_or_GtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "C>A / G>T"
Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "TtoC_or_AtoG_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "T>C / A>G"
Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "UniqueSynonymousVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "Synonymous"
Spearman_summary$mutation[Spearman_summary$mutation == "UniqueIntronicVariantsPlusOnePerBP"] <- "Intronic"

Spearman_summary$mutation <- factor(
  Spearman_summary$mutation,
  levels = c(
    "All Variants",
    "Synonymous",
    "Intronic",
    "C>T / G>A",
    "C>G / G>C",
    "C>A / G>T",
    "T>G / A>C",
    "T>A / A>T",
    "T>C / A>G"))

pal <- setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(length(levels(Spearman_summary$mutation))),
  levels(Spearman_summary$mutation)
)

# ============================================================
# PLOT: ONE FIGURE PER SPECIES, MULTIPLE MUTATION LINES
# ============================================================
for (species_name in unique(Spearman_summary$species)) {

  df_plot <- subset(Spearman_summary, species == species_name)

  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(
      x = timepoint,
      y = coefficient,
      colour = mutation,
      group = mutation
    )
  ) +
   # geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_point(aes(size = neglog10p), alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(group = mutation, colour = mutation),
      method = "loess",
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_size(range = c(0.1, 2)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(species_name, " Mutation Rate vs Expression Across Development"),
      subtitle = "Each line = mutation type",
      x = "Embryonic Timepoint",
      y = "Spearman Correlation Coefficient (ρ)",
      colour = "Mutation Type",
      size = expression(-log[10](p))
    ) +
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE-3),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm")) +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 12) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 14) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#ff5a1f",
                                 "#ff9f68",
                                 "#ffd983",
                                 "#e599ff",
                                 "#d966ff",
                                 "#cc33ff",
                                 "#bf00ff",
                                 "#730099",
                                 "#35063e"))

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      R_Data,
      "Plots/6_Mutation_and_TimeSeries_Expression_Association_Plots/",
      species_name,
      "_MutationType_Correlation_Trajectories.png"
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 4,
    height = 3.25,
    dpi = 2500,
    create.dir = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r Profiling Overall and Mutation-Group Expression Across Development}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

cluster_results <- list()

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  # --- Species name ---
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]

  # --- Load data ---
  df <- as.data.frame(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]])

  # --- Keep ONLY expression columns that end in a numeric timepoint ---
  expr_cols <- grep("^log2_Expression_Plus_One[0-9]+$", names(df), value = TRUE)

  if (length(expr_cols) == 0) next

  # --- Order expression columns numerically ---
  timepoints <- as.numeric(sub("^log2_Expression_Plus_One", "", expr_cols))
  ord <- order(timepoints)
  expr_cols <- expr_cols[ord]
  timepoints <- timepoints[ord]

  # --- Keep gene IDs + expression columns ---
  expression_and_meta <- df[, c("GENE_ID","UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP", "Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group", expr_cols), drop = FALSE] %>% unique()

  # --- Remove rows with missing values in expression columns only ---
  expression_and_meta <- expression_and_meta[
    complete.cases(expression_and_meta[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE]),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # --- Build expression matrix ---
  expression <- expression_and_meta[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE]
  expr_mat <- as.matrix(expression)
  colnames(expr_mat) <- timepoints
  
  # Make Long Format Expression Table to Plot Expression of Groups Across Timepoints
  long_expression_and_meta <- expression_and_meta %>%
  # 1. Rename expression columns (keep GENE_ID + metadata untouched)
  rename_with(
    ~ sub("log2_Expression_Plus_One", "", .x),
    starts_with("log2_Expression_Plus_One")
  ) %>%
  
  # 2. Pivot to long format
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^[0-9]+$"),   # only numeric column names
    names_to = "timepoint",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. Make timepoint numeric
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))
  
  
  # Summarise to Group Means and Medians
  summary_df <- long_expression_and_meta %>%
  group_by(Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expression   = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_expression     = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    n                 = n(),
    se_expression     = sd_expression / sqrt(n),
    Q1 = quantile(expression, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(expression, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
  # Plot Mean Expression of Each Mutation Group Across Development
  Mean_Expression_per_Mutation_Group_Plot <- 
  ggplot(summary_df,
       aes(x = timepoint,
           y = mean_expression,
           colour = Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group,
           fill = Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_expression - se_expression,
                    ymax = mean_expression + se_expression,
                    fill = Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group),
                alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = 
    colorRampPalette(c("green", "orange", "purple"))(length(unique(summary_df$Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group)))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = 
    colorRampPalette(c("green", "orange", "purple"))(length(unique(summary_df$Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group)))) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(species_name, "\n", "Mean Gene Expression by Mutation-Rate Quantile"),
      subtitle = paste0("Expression Trajectories Across Embryonic Time (n = ", "5", " Quantiles)"),
      x = "Embryonic Timepoint",
      y = "Mean log2(Expression + 1)",
      color = "Mutation-Rate Quantile",
      fill = "Mutation-Rate Quantile"
    ) +
   geom_line(linewidth = 1, colour = "black") +
  # main points, scaled by significance, colored by correlation, with black borders
  geom_point(
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    shape = 21,              # allows fill + border
    stroke = 0.4,            # border thickness
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
          scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
          scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) 
    
    
  ggsave(Mean_Expression_per_Mutation_Group_Plot,
         filename = 
   paste0(
      R_Data,
      "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering/",
      "Developmental_TimeSeries_Mean_Expression_per_Mutation_Group_Plot_",
      species_name,
      ".png"),
     width = 7,
    height = 5,
    create.dir = TRUE,
    dpi = 900)

  # Plot Median Expression of Each Mutation Group Across Development
  Median_Expression_per_Mutation_Group_Plot <- 
  ggplot(summary_df,
       aes(x = timepoint,
           y = median_expression,
           colour = Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group,
           fill = Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = Q1, ymax = Q3, fill = Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group),
    alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = 
    colorRampPalette(c("red", "orange", "yellow"))(length(unique(summary_df$Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group)))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = 
    colorRampPalette(c("red", "orange", "yellow"))(length(unique(summary_df$Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group)))) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(species_name, "\n", "Median Gene Expression by Mutation-Rate Quantile"),
      subtitle = paste0("Expression Trajectories Across Embryonic Time (n = ", "5", " Quantiles)"),
      x = "Embryonic Timepoint",
      y = "Mean log2(Expression + 1)",
      color = "Mutation-Rate Quantile",
      fill = "Mutation-Rate Quantile"
    ) 
    

  ggsave(Median_Expression_per_Mutation_Group_Plot,
         filename = 
   paste0(
      R_Data,
      "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering/",
      "Developmental_TimeSeries_Median_Expression_per_Mutation_Group_Plot_",
      species_name,
      ".png"),
    width = 6,
    create.dir = TRUE,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 900)
  
  
  
  # Summarise to OVERALL Mean and Median
  overall_summary_df <- long_expression_and_meta %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expression   = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_expression     = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    n                 = n(),
    se_expression     = sd_expression / sqrt(n),
    Q1 = quantile(expression, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(expression, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
  overall_summary_df$species <- species_name
  
  # Plot Mean Expression Across Development
  Mean_Expression_Plot <- 
  ggplot(overall_summary_df,
       aes(x = timepoint,
           y = mean_expression,
           colour = mean_expression,
           fill = mean_expression)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, colour = "black") +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_expression - se_expression,
        ymax = mean_expression + se_expression),
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "purple",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  # main points, scaled by significance, colored by correlation, with black borders
  geom_point(
    size = 5,
    colour = "black",
    shape = 21,              # allows fill + border
    stroke = 0.4,            # border thickness
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "green", high = "orange") +
          scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
          scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  # labels
  labs(
    x = "Developmental Timepoint",
    y = "Mean Embryonic Expression",
    fill  = "Correlation (ρ)",
    title = "Mean Embryonic Gene Expression vs Expression-Mutation-Rate Associations",
    subtitle = "Each Point Represents a Spearman Correlation per Timepoint per Species",
    caption = "Dashed Line = LOESS Smooth; Point Size ∝ Significance (p-value)"
  )
  
  ggsave(Mean_Expression_Plot,
         filename = 
   paste0(
      R_Data,
      "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering/",
      "Developmental_TimeSeries_Mean_Expression_Plot_",
      species_name,
      ".png"),
    width = 6,
    create.dir = TRUE,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 900)

  # Plot Median Expression of Each Mutation Group Across Development
  Median_Expression_Plot <- 
  ggplot(overall_summary_df,
       aes(x = timepoint,
           y = median_expression,
           colour = median_expression,
           fill = median_expression)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, colour = "black") +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = Q1,
        ymax = Q3),
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "purple",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  # main points, scaled by significance, colored by correlation, with black borders
  geom_point(
    size = 5,
    colour = "black",
    shape = 21,              # allows fill + border
    stroke = 0.4,            # border thickness
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "green", high = "orange") +
          scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
          scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  # labels
  labs(
    x = "Developmental Timepoint",
    y = "Median Embryonic Expression",
    fill  = "Correlation (ρ)",
    title = "Median Embryonic Gene Expression vs Expression-Mutation-Rate Associations",
    subtitle = "Each Point Represents a Spearman Correlation per Timepoint per Species",
    caption = "Dashed Line = LOESS Smooth; Point Size ∝ Significance (p-value)"
  ) 
  
  ggsave(Median_Expression_Plot,
         filename = 
   paste0(
      R_Data,
      "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering/",
      "Developmental_TimeSeries_Median_Expression_Plot_",
      species_name,
      ".png"),
    width = 6,
    create.dir = TRUE,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 900)
  
  # Merge overall expression trends with overall expression-mutation rate association scores for plotting
  overall_summary_with_associations_df <- 
    merge(overall_summary_df,
          Spearman_summary,
          by = c("timepoint","species"))
  
  label_y <- switch(
  species_name,
  "Dmelanogaster" = 0.05,
  "Celegans" = 0.1,
  "Ppacificus" = -0.27
)
  
  
  
  mean_expression_vs_association_plot <- 
  ggplot(data = overall_summary_with_associations_df,
         aes(x = mean_expression, y = coefficient, group = mutation, colour = mutation, fill = mutation)) +
   # smooth curve
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", alpha = .05,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  # main points, scaled by significance, colored by correlation, with black borders
  geom_point(
    aes(size = -log10(p_value), fill = mutation),
    shape = 21,              # allows fill + border
    color = "black",         # border color
    stroke = 0.4,            # border thickness
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  stat_cor(
  method = "spearman",
  label.x.npc = 1,
  label.y = label_y,
  hjust = 1,
  vjust = c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9),
  size = 3) +
 # scale_fill_gradient(low = "green", high = "purple") +

                                 "#cc33ff",

                                 "#e599ff",

                                 "#cc33ff",
                                 "#bf00ff",
                                 "#730099",
                                 "#35063e")) +
          scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
          scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  # labels
  labs(
    x = "Mean Embryonic Expression",
    y = "Spearman Correlation Coefficient (ρ)",
    fill  = "Correlation (ρ)",
    size  = expression(-log[10](p)),
    title = "Mean Embryonic Gene Expression vs Expression-Mutation-Rate Associations",
    subtitle = "Each Point Represents a Spearman Correlation per Timepoint per Species",
    caption = "Dashed Line = LOESS Smooth; Point Size ∝ Significance (p-value)"
  ) + guides(colour = "none", line = "none") +
    theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),

ggsave(

        "_Mean_Expression_vs_MutationRate-Expression_Coefficients_Across_Development.png"
```

```{r Clustering Heatmaps and TimeSeries of Developmental Expression }
options(bitmapType = "cairo")

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

gc()

species_k <- c(
  "Celegans" = 7,
  "Ppacificus" = 6,
  "Dmelanogaster" = 9
)

default_k <- 6L

max_k <- max(c(default_k, unname(species_k)), na.rm = TRUE)
cluster_palette_all <- setNames(
  grDevices::hcl.colors(max_k, palette = "Purple-Green"),
  as.character(seq_len(max_k))
)

out_dir <- file.path(R_Data, "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cluster_results <- list()

# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTION
# ============================================================
process_clustering <- function(mat, meta_df, species_name, label, k_use) {

  if (nrow(mat) < 3) return(NULL)

  # ----------------------------
  # Colour scale
  # ----------------------------
  if (label == "scaled") {
    heatmap_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
      c(-4, 0, 4),
      c("#5A189A", "white", "#FF9100")
    )
  } else {
    q <- quantile(mat, probs = c(0.01, 0.5, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
    heatmap_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
      c(q[1], q[2], q[3]),
      c("#5A189A", "white", "#FF9100")
    )
  }

  set.seed(69)

  ht <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    col = heatmap_col_fun,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_km = k_use,
    row_km_repeats = 20,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    border = TRUE
  )

  png(file.path(out_dir, paste0("Heatmap_", species_name, "_", label, ".png")),
      width = 3000, height = 5000, res = 900, type = "cairo-png")
  ht_drawn <- draw(ht)
  dev.off()

  cluster_list <- row_order(ht_drawn)

  cluster_vec <- rep(NA, nrow(mat))
  for (i in seq_along(cluster_list)) {
    cluster_vec[cluster_list[[i]]] <- i
  }

  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    row_id = rownames(mat),
    cluster = factor(cluster_vec)
  )

  clustered_df <- merge(meta_df, cluster_df, by = "row_id")

  # ============================================================
  # EXPRESSION TRAJECTORIES (MEAN + MEDIAN + CI)
  # ============================================================

  expr_df <- as.data.frame(mat)
  expr_df$row_id <- rownames(mat)
  expr_df$cluster <- factor(cluster_vec)

  long_df <- expr_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(row_id, cluster),
      names_to = "time",
      values_to = "expression"
    ) %>%
    mutate(time = as.numeric(time))

  summary_df <- long_df %>%
    group_by(cluster, time) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_expr = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_expr   = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
      n         = sum(!is.na(expression)),
      se_expr   = sd_expr / sqrt(n),

      median_expr = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
      q1          = quantile(expression, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3          = quantile(expression, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ---- Mean plot ----
  p_mean <- ggplot(summary_df,
                   aes(x = time,
                       y = mean_expr,
                       group = cluster)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_expr - 1.96 * se_expr,
                    ymax = mean_expr + 1.96 * se_expr),
                fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "black") +
    facet_grid(cluster ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(species_name, " Cluster Mean Expression (", label, ")"),
      x = "Time",
      y = "Mean Expression"
    )

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir,
                   paste0("ClusterMeanExpression_", species_name, "_", label, ".png")),
         p_mean, width = 4, height = 10, dpi = 2000)

  # ---- Median plot ----
  p_median <- ggplot(summary_df,
                     aes(x = time,
                         y = median_expr,
                         group = cluster)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3),
                fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "black") +
    facet_grid(cluster ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(species_name, " Cluster Median Expression (", label, ")"),
      x = "Time",
      y = "Median Expression"
    )

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir,
                   paste0("ClusterMedianExpression_", species_name, "_", label, ".png")),
         p_median, width = 4, height = 10, dpi = 2000)

  # ============================================================
  # MUTATION RATE BOXPLOT (defines cluster order)
  # ============================================================

  if ("UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" %in% names(clustered_df)) {

    cluster_order <- clustered_df %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      summarise(med = median(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      arrange(med) %>%
      pull(cluster)

    clustered_df$cluster <- factor(clustered_df$cluster, levels = cluster_order)

    p_mut <- ggplot(clustered_df,
                    aes(x = cluster,
                        y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
                        fill = cluster)) +
      geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_palette_all) +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      labs(title = paste0(species_name, " Mutation Rate (", label, ")"))

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir,
                     paste0("MutationRate_", species_name, "_", label, ".png")),
           p_mut, width = 2.5, height = 4, dpi = 1500)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # dNdS BOXPLOT (aligned to same order)
  # ============================================================

  if ("dNdS" %in% names(clustered_df)) {

    dnds_df <- clustered_df[!is.na(clustered_df$dNdS), ]

    if (nrow(dnds_df) > 0 && length(unique(dnds_df$cluster)) > 1) {

      p_dnds <- ggplot(dnds_df,
                       aes(x = cluster,
                           y = dNdS,
                           fill = cluster)) +
        geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_palette_all) +
        theme(legend.position = "none") +
        labs(title = paste0(species_name, " dNdS (", label, ")"))

      ggsave(file.path(out_dir,
                       paste0("dNdS_", species_name, "_", label, ".png")),
             p_dnds, width = 2.5, height = 4, dpi = 1500)
    }
  }

  return(clustered_df)
}

# ============================================================
# MAIN LOOP
# ============================================================

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  df <- as.data.frame(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]])

  expr_cols <- grep("^log2_Expression_Plus_One[0-9]+$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(expr_cols) == 0) next

  timepoints <- as.numeric(sub("^log2_Expression_Plus_One", "", expr_cols))
  ord <- order(timepoints)

  expr_cols <- expr_cols[ord]
  timepoints <- timepoints[ord]

  keep_cols <- c("GENE_ID", "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP", "dNdS", expr_cols)
  keep_cols <- intersect(keep_cols, names(df))

  expression_and_meta <- df[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% unique()

  expression_and_meta <- expression_and_meta[
    complete.cases(expression_and_meta[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE]),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(expression_and_meta) < 3) next

  expr_mat <- as.matrix(expression_and_meta[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"

  row_id <- make.unique(as.character(expression_and_meta$GENE_ID))

  row_scaled_expression <- t(scale(t(expr_mat)))
  row_scaled_expression[row_scaled_expression > 4] <- 4
  row_scaled_expression[row_scaled_expression < -4] <- -4

  keep <- apply(row_scaled_expression, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x)))

  row_scaled_expression <- row_scaled_expression[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  expr_mat <- expr_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  expression_and_meta <- expression_and_meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  row_id <- row_id[keep]

  if (nrow(row_scaled_expression) < 3) next

  rownames(row_scaled_expression) <- row_id
  rownames(expr_mat) <- row_id

  colnames(row_scaled_expression) <- as.character(timepoints)
  colnames(expr_mat) <- as.character(timepoints)

  expression_and_meta$row_id <- row_id

  if (species_name %in% names(species_k)) {
    k_use <- species_k[[species_name]]
  } else {
    k_use <- default_k
  }

  k_use <- max(2, min(k_use, nrow(row_scaled_expression) - 1))

  clustered_scaled <- process_clustering(
    row_scaled_expression,
    expression_and_meta,
    species_name,
    "scaled",
    k_use
  )

  clustered_unscaled <- process_clustering(
    expr_mat,
    expression_and_meta,
    species_name,
    "unscaled",
    k_use
  )

  cluster_results[[species_name]] <- list(
    scaled = clustered_scaled,
    unscaled = clustered_unscaled
  )
}
```

```{r ORA}
# ============================================================
# GO OVER-REPRESENTATION ENRICHMENT FOR K-MEANS CLUSTERS
# (BP + CC + MF)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Ce.eg.db)
  library(org.Dm.eg.db)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})

for (species_name in names(cluster_results)) {

  if (!(species_name %in% c("Celegans", "Dmelanogaster"))) next

  clustered_df <- cluster_results[[species_name]]$unscaled
  if (is.null(clustered_df)) next

  # ----------------------------
  # Species setup
  # ----------------------------
  if (species_name == "Celegans") {
    orgdb <- org.Ce.eg.db
    keytype_used <- "WORMBASE"
    species_tag <- "Celegans"
  } else {
    orgdb <- org.Dm.eg.db
    keytype_used <- "FLYBASE"
    species_tag <- "Dmelanogaster"
  }

  message("Running cluster enrichment for: ", species_name)

  species_out_dir <- file.path(
    R_Data,
    "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering/Cluster_GO_Enrichment",
    species_tag
  )
  dir.create(species_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # ----------------------------
  # Loop over clusters
  # ----------------------------
  for (cl in sort(unique(na.omit(clustered_df$cluster)))) {

    df_cl <- clustered_df %>%
      filter(cluster == cl) %>%
      distinct(GENE_ID)

    genes <- df_cl$GENE_ID

    if (length(genes) < 10) {
      message("Skipping cluster ", cl, " (too few genes: ", length(genes), ")")
      next
    }

    message("Cluster ", cl, " genes: ", length(genes))

    # ----------------------------
    # LOOP OVER ONTOLOGIES
    # ----------------------------
    for (ont_type in c("BP", "CC", "MF")) {

      message("  Running ", ont_type, "...")

      enrich_res <- tryCatch(
        enrichGO(
          gene = genes,
          OrgDb = orgdb,
          keyType = keytype_used,
          ont = ont_type,
          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
          pvalueCutoff = 1,
          qvalueCutoff = 1,
          readable = TRUE
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          message("  enrichGO failed for cluster ", cl, " (", ont_type, "): ", e$message)
          return(NULL)
        }
      )

      if (is.null(enrich_res)) next

      enrich_df <- as.data.frame(enrich_res)
      if (nrow(enrich_df) == 0) {
        message("  No GO terms for ", ont_type)
        next
      }

      # ----------------------------
      # Save table
      # ----------------------------
      write.table(
        enrich_df,
        file = file.path(
          species_out_dir,
          paste0(species_name, "_Cluster_", cl, "_", ont_type, "_GO_Unscaled.tsv")
        ),
        sep = "\t",
        row.names = FALSE,
        quote = FALSE
      )

      # ----------------------------
      # Plot
      # ----------------------------
      plot_df <- enrich_df %>%
        arrange(p.adjust) %>%
        slice_head(n = 15) %>%
        mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(Description)))

      p_bar <- ggplot(plot_df,
                      aes(x = Description,
                          y = -log10(p.adjust),
                          fill = Count)) +
        geom_col(width = 0.7) +
        coord_flip() +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = "purple", high = "orange") +
        labs(
          title = paste0(species_tag, " Cluster ", cl, " ", ont_type, " GO enrichment"),
          x = NULL,
          y = "-log10(adj p-value)"
        )

      ggsave(
        plot = p_bar,
        filename = file.path(
          species_out_dir,
          paste0(species_name, "_Cluster_", cl, "_", ont_type, "_GO_barplot_Unscaled.png")
        ),
        width = 7,
        height = 5,
        dpi = 800,
        bg = "white"
      )
    }
  }
}
```

```{r Saving}
save(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants, file = paste0(R_Data, "Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants"))
```
